preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in s for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: All characters in the output list must be present in the input string.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for c in s if s.count(c) % 2 != 0)
postconditions.description: The length of the output list must equal the number of unpaired characters in the input string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == [s[i] for i in range(len(s)) if s.count(s[i]) % 2 != 0 and i == s.rindex(s[i])][:len(return_value)]
postconditions.description: The output list must contain the last occurrences of unpaired characters in the order they were encountered.
